database: foodlink_test in independent ephemeral PostgreSQL16.15 cluster

scenarios: Readiness, camelCase response contracts and anonymous access boundaries
Real password login, protected session cookies, CSRF/origin checks and malformed inputs
Registration, captured email verification, replay rejection and recipient eligibility approval
Owned donor offer remains unavailable until staff receipt, preserving original quantity
Invalid quantities, negative contributions, spoofed identity and atomic basket rollback
Idempotency replay returns same reservation and rejects different body with same key
Last-unit concurrent reservation has exactly one winner and no negative stock
Simultaneous identical idempotency submissions create one order and one stock movement
Cancellation restores stock once and preserves history
Early pickup blocked, valid pickup redeemed once and impact matches distributed weight
No-show, item expiry and event cancellation reconcile stock
Private offered images, valid PNG decoding/WebP reencoding, type/size/truncation rejection, ownership and deletion
Delivery assignment, required proof, authorized completion and replay rejection
Surplus allocation restrictions, disabled purchases and rejected unsigned payment events
Accurate period reports, scoped notifications, disposal ledger and administrative audits
Password recovery through captured SMTP revokes prior sessions and rejects token replay
Disabled account sessions revoked, last admin protected, ledger balances reconcile, no leaked transactions
Expired sessions rejected, personal exports scoped, volunteer tasks assigned and completed
Password recovery invalidates an in-flight login using the previous password
Full-period report totals remain accurate above the 2000-detail limit
Assignment directory filters active verified staff before pagination and redacts unrelated user details
Deactivation serializes with an in-flight reservation; anonymization refuses active work
Stale donation and profile writes cannot recreate personal records after disable
Forged and stale signatures cannot change data
Payment amount, currency, session and order must match stored values
Paid confirmation is exactly once and later expiry cannot cancel it
Asynchronous payment success required after unpaid checkout completion
Failed/expired pending checkout restores stock once
Late payment queues a refund and cannot resurrect inventory
Refund releases uncollected stock once and rejects payment replay reversal
Refund preserves completed fulfillment and distributed stock
Pending/failed refunds block collection and validate amount
Refund before confirmation remains refunded after delayed confirmation
Partial refund queues remaining balance without reporting full refund
Administrator retry preserves attempt identity and ignores superseded failures
paymentWebhooks.providerRequests: none; synthetic signatures/test credentials, background provider processing disabled

deliveryChecks.composeConfiguration: passed for development, tests and synthetic production settings

notes: SQL-backed acceptance testing exposed and led to a fix for a reserved-word alias in the impact query
All tests used isolated test databases, private local object storage and captured local SMTP
Original development data and volumes were not removed or reset
No hosting deployment, external email send or real payment was performed
Final regression runs include independent review fixes and owner-only pickup ticket visibility; a test-only PostgreSQL lock barrier was corrected to follow indirect wait chains
